name: fair_candy
doc: With Marle: down to the fair (loc 005), the girl by the fountain says Lucca's show is ready ($7F0055 bit7: the twins on the north stairs of loc 1B7 go away); back up to 1B7 and toward the north stairs, Marle's candy stop (walk away twice: 'Give me a second', 'no need to drag me'; then she buys it) and she follows again. Crono by the candy stand.
